---
description: Run the backend tests and report the results
---

Run the relevant automated tests for the current repository.

Requirements:
- Identify the correct test command from the project configuration.
- Run the smallest relevant test set first.
- Report the number of passed and failed tests.
- Explain the likely cause of any failure.
- Do not modify production code unless explicitly requested.
- Do not claim success unless the test command finishes successfully.
